aboutPage.title: Eight years of shipping, pointed at AI
aboutPage.lede: I am a fullstack developer who spent most of a decade making e-commerce and mobile products work, and now spends it making AI features work inside them.
aboutPage.story1: I started where a lot of European web developers start: PHP, PrestaShop, and stores that had to stay online through Black Friday. That taught me the thing that matters most about production software — it is not the feature that is hard, it is the failure mode.
aboutPage.story2: Over eight years that widened into Laravel APIs, Vue dashboards, and Flutter apps on Firebase. A to Z delivery: scoping, building, deploying, and then living with what I shipped.
aboutPage.story3: When LLMs became genuinely useful I did not switch careers, I pointed the same discipline at them. Agents that retry properly. Prompts that are regression-tested. Caching that is measured rather than assumed. The writing on this site is that work, in the open.

aboutPage.philosophy: Ship the smallest thing that proves the idea, instrument it so you know when it breaks, then make it fast. I take critical feedback well and I stay for the maintenance — which is usually the part that decides whether a project was worth doing.
